svg.text: Every project here is doing important work for cryptocurrency freedom. This table just shows where each one shines.
No KYC, no email, no ID required
Four parallel networks (clearnet + Tor + I2P + Lokinet)
Immutable on-chain chat history (operator cannot delete)
Block explorer built in (no third-party tracking)
No cookies, no cookie banner, nothing to consent to
No CDN — every asset served from the operator
No Google Fonts, no third-party font network
IPs never logged at any layer
No fingerprinting via canvas / WebGL / fonts
All env vars marked secret are validated and redacted in logs
Never been hacked — platform holds no funds to drain
On-chain immutable reputation that survives operator shutdown
Immutable feedback (no operator can edit or remove)
Reproducible builds with on-chain release attestation
Per-IP rate limiting at API edge
Argon2id key derivation for keystore unlock
Subresource Integrity (SRI) on every script tag
Public report of every fixed security finding
Public audit log — every finding, every fix, every accepted risk
Adversarial red-team narratives + STRIDE threat modeling
Thousands of self-checking smoke tests in the source tree
AGPL-3.0 — modified instances must publish source
Open source under any OSI-approved license
No PHP / WordPress / XML-RPC / OAuth attack surface
Zero known unpatched CVEs in shipped dependencies
Dependency hygiene audit documented per release
No eval(), no Function(), no dynamic code paths anywhere
Zod-validated request bodies with bounded field lengths
Parameterized SQL — no string concatenation queries
One-click trade relist when an order expires
Operator earns ~2% on idle treasury while users trade
Orderbook filters by network, payment method, country
Custom amount-range alerts (notify when a $X trade appears)
Multi-device pairing via signed QR session
Works in any modern browser (Firefox / Chromium / Safari / Edge)
Progressive Web App (installable on iPhone & Android)
Public read-only orderbook (no signup to browse)
Self-host on a $5/month VPS or Raspberry Pi
Public API for wallet developers and third-party tools
Works in Tor Browser at default security settings
Works on a Raspberry Pi Zero / 4G phone
Works on old hardware (iPhone 5 / Android 6 era)
Bundle weight under 200 KB on first paint
Lazy-loaded images and deferred non-critical CSS
Multi-network stablecoins (ERC-20 / TRC-20 / BEP-20 / Polygon / Solana / Arbitrum / Base)
Cash by mail with carrier-tracking workflow
Federated multi-operator network with shared orderbook
Anyone can run an instance without permission
No single point of failure — survives any operator shutdown
Operator can earn revenue from their instance
AGPL guarantees source availability of modifications
No central API — every endpoint is operator-owned
Multiple instances visible on .onion, .i2p, .loki AND clearnet
Public Matrix room — operators and users hang out together
No NDA required to report bugs
No CLA — copyright stays with contributors
All commits in a public Forgejo instance (no GitHub dependency)
Public release-signing key with a verifiable provenance trail
GPG-signed release tarballs + on-chain bundle hash manifest
Self-auditing brag list (CI verifies every claim)
Documentation kept in lockstep with code (paired-update rule)
As of 2026-05-24. Information about other platforms gathered from their public docs and recent independent reviews; corrections welcome via Matrix #agorise:matrix.org.
